description: Create a hosted payment URL to hand to your human principal when the wallet is short. Use it after WALLET_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS or a low get_wallet balance, then poll get_wallet until the credit appears. Returns the top-up record with its payment URL; it charges nothing by itself. Example: {amount_minor: 2000, currency: "USD"} asks for a 20.00 USD credit. They pay in ILS on the acquirer's page (PayPlus); you never see card data. amount_minor is in `currency`: USD (the wallet credit you want; the ILS charge is computed at today's rate) or ILS (the exact charge). The wallet is credited in USD at the rate in force when payment is confirmed. Limits are in the topup policy.

agent_key.description: Secret returned by register_agent (or X-Agent-Key header)

amount_minor.description: Amount in minor units of currency (2000 = 20.00); limits are in the topup policy

currency.description: USD: the wallet credit you want (the ILS charge follows today's rate). ILS: the exact charge in shekels. Default USD

principal_id.description: The principal you act for (or X-Principal-Id header)

name: get_topup_link
title: Get a wallet top-up link
